exec_summary: Site traffic (GA4, 2026-05-03 to 2026-05-09): growthbook.io had 12,818 sessions and 7,874 users (+9.5% week over week).

**Site performance**
- **Overall (GA4, all traffic):** 12,818 sessions (+9.5% WoW) | 7,874 users (WoW% not provided separately)
- **Overall (GSC, organic search):** 3,432 clicks (-9.1% WoW) | 166,840 impressions (+15.6% WoW)
- **Homepage (/):** 9,557 GA4 sessions (+17.5% WoW) all-traffic | 1,938 GSC clicks (-8.2% WoW) | 25,739 GSC impressions (+12.8% WoW)
- **Pricing (/pricing):** 1,216 GA4 sessions (-4.8% WoW) all-traffic | 92 GSC clicks (-21.4% WoW) | 6,770 GSC impressions (+29.8% WoW)
- **Docs (docs.growthbook.io):** 4,862 GA4 sessions (+5.7% WoW) all-traffic | 1,176 GSC clicks (-10.4% WoW) | 134,948 GSC impressions (+28.6% WoW)
- **All other pages:** 4,747 GA4 sessions (-8.7% WoW) all-traffic | 184 GSC clicks (-9.8% WoW) | 121,435 GSC impressions (+12.6% WoW)

Pricing is the notable divergence: impressions up +29.8% (more people seeing GrowthBook in pricing-related SERPs) while organic clicks fell -21.4% and all-traffic sessions fell -4.8%. Worth monitoring whether AI assistants are satisfying pricing intent without a click. Homepage all-traffic up +17.5% while organic clicks fell -8.2% — consistent with AI-source referrals not captured by GSC.

**New competitor activity**
- **Optimizely** launched a coordinated cluster of 13 vertical-specific use-case posts this week (financial services, healthcare, retail, B2B SaaS) — all tagged threat score 7, relevance tier 1. This is a deliberate SEO content campaign targeting buyers who search by industry. GrowthBook has no equivalent vertical use-case content and risks being invisible when a fintech or healthcare buyer searches "A/B testing for [industry]."
- **LaunchDarkly** published changelog entries for native Databricks and Redshift experimentation integrations. These directly compete with GrowthBook's warehouse-native positioning — LaunchDarkly is now explicitly messaging data-warehouse-connected experimentation to the same audience.
- **Harness** published two experimentation-focused assets this week: a blog on A/B testing at scale for platform teams and a resource titled "Experimentation Your Secret Weapon" — signals they are pushing experimentation more aggressively as a use case, not just feature flags.
- **PostHog** published multiple community Q&A pages around experiment exposure bugs ("0 exposures" issues). These will rank for frustrated PostHog users searching for help — a potential switcher-capture moment GrowthBook is not positioned to intercept.

**New GrowthBook content**
- 10 pages noticed this week via sitemap (all detected 2026-05-10, real publish dates unknown):
  - **/insights/best-mobile-app-analytics-tools** (KD 15 — has search demand, could gain traction quickly)
  - **/blog/12-common-feature-flag-mistakes-to-avoid**
  - **/blog/a-practitioners-guide-to-treatment-effects-in-experimentation-ate-cate-itt-late-att-explained**
  - **/blog/new-feature-save-time-with-automatic-metric-generation**
  - **/guides/7-steps-to-better-experiment-design**
  - **/guides/the-a-b-testing-playbook-for-al-powered-apps**
  - **/insights/alternatives-posthog-developers**
  - **/insights/best-ab-testing-tools-product-analytics**
  - **/insights/best-ab-testing-tools-product-managers**
  - **/insights/best-open-source-product-analytics-tools**
- Strong output week — 10 new URLs across blog, guides, and insights. None have GSC data yet.

**Organic movers worth watching**
- **"experimentation platform"** at position 13.1 with 428 impressions and **"ab testing platform"** at position 10.1 with 414 impressions are both in striking distance. These are high-intent, non-branded queries where a push to page 1 meaningfully changes lead volume.
- **"feature flagging open source"** at position 9.7 with 372 impressions — one spot from page 1, directly in GrowthBook's core positioning.
- **"launchdarkly business model b2b"** at position 10.2 with 851 impressions — highest-impression striking-distance query this week, likely a competitor-aware buyer. The **/compare/growthbook-vs-launchdarkly** page at position 8.5 is the natural landing page but only got 1 click this week vs. 4 last week.
- **/blog/what-are-feature-flags** gained 5 clicks WoW (1 to 6) — early traction on a high-volume keyword.
- **/solutions/ai** dropped from 8 to 2 clicks WoW (-75%). Worth checking whether this page is competing with the new AI playbook guide detected this week.

**Recommended actions**
- **Counter Optimizely's vertical use-case cluster:** They published 13 industry-specific experimentation posts this week. Prioritize 2-3 GrowthBook vertical use-case pages (fintech, healthcare, B2B SaaS) — these are quick wins per the opportunity scores and GrowthBook currently has no equivalent content.
- **Publish a Databricks/Redshift experimentation comparison page or blog:** LaunchDarkly just announced native integrations for both. GrowthBook's warehouse-native story needs visible content that captures searches from data-warehouse buyers before LaunchDarkly owns that SERP.
- **Optimize /compare/growthbook-vs-launchdarkly for "launchdarkly business model b2b":** 851 impressions at position 10.2 — highest-volume striking-distance query this week. A title/H1 refresh targeting that query could move this into page 1.
- **Create a "GrowthBook vs PostHog experiment setup" troubleshooting page:** PostHog is publishing community Q&A around experiment exposure bugs. Frustrated PostHog users are searching for answers — a targeted comparison or migration guide could intercept that audience at a high-intent moment.
